title: APS interconnection queue: Active Queue posting 2026-10-13 and cluster study reports
publisher: Arizona Public Service (OASIS), extracted on this machine
summary: The APS Active Queue posting of 2026-10-13 and the cluster system impact / facilities study reports posted through 2026-10-21, parsed and summarised on this machine by scripts/aps_queue.py (task 23).

findings.statement: APS's Active Queue posted 2026-10-13 lists 239 requests totalling 77,763 MW: 198 not yet in service (70,995 MW), 35 in service (6,304 MW) and 6 surplus requests (464 MW).

Pending requests by study cycle: 2026 Cluster 54 requests / 24,773 MW; 2025 Cluster 36 requests / 10,337 MW; 2024 Cluster 21 requests / 4,978 MW; Transition Cluster 42 requests / 16,456 MW; Pre-2024 (Transition or serial) 45 requests / 14,451 MW.

Pending MW by technology: Solar + storage hybrid 27.8 GW (39%), Storage 14.8 GW (21%), Natural Gas 11.1 GW (16%), Wind 6.7 GW (9%), Solar + storage + Natural Gas hybrid 4.5 GW (6%), Solar 2.3 GW (3%), Solar + Wind + storage hybrid 2.3 GW (3%).
Pending MW by service: NRIS 46.3 GW, ERIS 22.1 GW, NRIS+ERIS 2.6 GW, other 16 MW.

Pending MW by queue status: Phase 1 Cluster Study 25.1 GW, Transitional Cluster: LGIA (Draft) 8.9 GW, Customer Initiated Suspension 5.5 GW, Transitional Cluster: Phase 4 Facilities Study 5.4 GW, Project with APS Project Manager 3.0 GW, Phase 2 Cluster Study 2.0 GW, In Design 1.9 GW, Analysis For Sub-Cluster Re-Study 1.9 GW.

Pending MW by APS study area: Four Corners-Cholla 13.9 GW, Delaney-Sun Valley-Redhawk 13.6 GW, South of Phoenix 10.1 GW, Hoodoo Wash-Yuma 9.4 GW, Phoenix Metro 8.4 GW, Gila Bend 7.9 GW, NSTS (Navajo South) 7.6 GW, Northern (69 kV Flagstaff/Winslow) 170 MW.
findings.location: APS Active Queue posting 2026-10-13; study area from report rosters, POI rules and county

findings.statement: 28 pending requests (9,575 MW) have known or likely offtake: APS-owned / BTA 7 / 2,984 MW; APS PPA / tolling 19 / 6,041 MW; Other offtaker 2 / 550 MW. By study area: Four Corners-Cholla APS-owned / BTA 390 MW, APS PPA / tolling 2,452 MW; Delaney-Sun Valley-Redhawk APS-owned / BTA 393 MW, APS PPA / tolling 1,550 MW; Gila Bend APS-owned / BTA 1,255 MW; South of Phoenix APS-owned / BTA 695 MW, APS PPA / tolling 414 MW; Hoodoo Wash-Yuma APS-owned / BTA 250 MW, APS PPA / tolling 300 MW, Other offtaker 550 MW; NSTS (Navajo South) APS PPA / tolling 1,000 MW; Phoenix Metro APS PPA / tolling 325 MW. 4 of them (2,341 MW) are announced, not yet approved or executed: Q626, Q627, Q629, Q632.
findings.location: contracted.csv (curated from public offtake evidence: APS RFP results, ACC filings, PPA announcements)

findings.statement: Separately, 32 queue requests already in service (3,790 MW) have known offtake: APS-owned / BTA 17 / 1,404 MW; APS PPA / tolling 11 / 1,709 MW; Other offtaker 4 / 677 MW.

Largest pending POIs: Delaney 500 kV Substation 4.3 GW (10 requests); Cholla 500kV 3.8 GW (14 requests); Four Corners 345kV 3.5 GW (3 requests); TS30 500kV 3.0 GW (4 requests); Saguaro 500kV 2.7 GW (4 requests); Hoodoo Wash 500kV 2.0 GW (6 requests); Watermelon 500kV Substation 1.9 GW (2 requests); Panda 230kV 1.9 GW (6 requests).

10 pending requests (5,475 MW) are in customer-initiated suspension: Q320 1,500 MW Wind at Four Corners 345kV, Q318 1,000 MW Wind at Four Corners 345kV, Q319 1,000 MW Wind at Four Corners 345kV, Q379 1,000 MW Solar + storage hybrid at Sun Valley 500kV.

Attrition candidates: 56 pending requests (17,176 MW) show a projected in-service date before 2026 and are not in design or construction, e.g. Q274 1,000 MW at Cedar Mountain - Moonkopi 500 kV line (ISD 12/31/24, Transitional Cluster: LGIA (Executed)), Q466 1,000 MW at North Gila 500kV (ISD 12/31/25, Transitional Cluster: LGIA (Draft)), Q474 1,000 MW at Delaney 500kV (ISD 12/31/25, Project with APS Project Manager), Q379 1,000 MW at Sun Valley 500kV (ISD 6/1/24, Customer Initiated Suspension).
Requests still in the queue by submission year: 2023 12 / 3,484 MW; 2024 24 / 4,978 MW; 2025 32 / 9,247 MW; 2026 55 / 25,023 MW.

71 APS cluster system impact and facilities study reports are extracted (2024-06-24 to 2026-10-21), covering the Transition, 2024 and 2025 clusters in eight study areas; the 2026 cluster is not yet studied.

Network and station upgrade cost in the latest report of each cycle, by study area: South of Phoenix $1,344M, Four Corners-Cholla $1,176M, Gila Bend $428M, Hoodoo Wash-Yuma $102M, Phoenix Metro $58M, Delaney-Sun Valley-Redhawk $18M, NSTS (Navajo South) $15M.
findings.location: APS cluster study reports, latest version per cycle

findings.statement: Largest upgrades in the latest reports: New Sitgreaves–Pinnacle Peak 500 kV line ($1,000M, Four Corners-Cholla 2025 Ph1, first triggered by Q609 at 700 MW cumulative); Construct Saguaro-Bianco-Independence 500 kV Line, including 2-600 MVA 500/230 kV Transfor ($967M, South of Phoenix 2025 Ph1, first triggered by Q578 at 300 MW cumulative); Rebuild Saguaro-Q618 230 kV Line (25.2 miles) ($202M, South of Phoenix 2025 Ph1, first triggered by Q604 at 1,880 MW cumulative); Second Jojoba - Watermelon 500 kV line (20 miles) ($180M, Gila Bend 2025 Ph2, first triggered by Q581 at 400 MW cumulative); Sitgreaves 500 kV station ($150M, Four Corners-Cholla 2025 Ph1, first triggered by Q609 at 700 MW cumulative).
findings.location: APS cluster study reports, latest version per cycle
